Fiora.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Resistance doesn’t affect the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance or Fiora R Grand Challenge, and R scales with max health, so don’t rely on stacking only health. Since she has strong healing, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora W Riposte and Fiora Q Lunge are down, place Yorick W Dark Procession first in her escape path. Then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and follow with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and a basic attack. If you have enough graves nearby, use Q’s empowered basic attack, then recast Q to raise Mist Walkers.
Fiora.escape: The moment after you bait out Fiora Q Lunge is Yorick’s window to close the distance. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and engage. If Riposte is still available, W can be blocked and you can be stunned, so don’t rush in.
Fiora.fight: When Fiora steps forward to last-hit, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then close in using the slow and movement speed to land Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack. If E misses, don’t force a chase with your short range. Save Yorick W Dark Procession while Fiora W Riposte is available, and after Riposte has been spent, target the moment when she also uses Fiora Q Lunge.
Fiora.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and counterattack with Yorick E Mourning Mist when Fiora comes in toward a vital. Don’t force your way in when E is unavailable, and if Fiora pushes the lane and leaves, gain an advantage by pressuring the turret.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, press your body against a wall to block one side’s vital. Raise Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and attack the target Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist is hitting.
Fiora.watch: Fiora Q Lunge can cross Yorick W Dark Procession, so don’t rely on W alone to trap her while Q is available. Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects, and stuns you if it blocks an immobilizing effect, so don’t use W carelessly while Riposte is available. When Fiora dives toward a vital, stand on the opposite side to limit her angle of attack.

Illaoi.teamfight: Don't fight near Illaoi's tentacles; if you don't have time to destroy them, draw her away from the wall. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith is activated, spread out from your allies and wait out its brief damage window. Before a fight, Yorick should awaken the Mist Walkers and block a passage with Yorick W Dark Procession, then hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send the Mist Walkers after them.
Illaoi.watch: Last-hit from outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit so she can't pull your spirit. Illaoi R Leap of Faith concentrates a lot of damage in a short time, so when she uses it, create distance and don't group with your allies.
Illaoi.build: Prioritize armor against Illaoi's main damage. She has strong healing, so fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item, and calculate whether you can secure a kill while healing reduction is applied.
Illaoi.combo: After Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in her escape route and mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Then land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and a regular basic attack. If you have enough graves nearby, spend the empowered basic attack, then press Yorick Q Last Rites again to raise the Mist Walkers.
Illaoi.escape: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit; the opening to engage comes just after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down. If you block her escape route with Yorick W Dark Procession then, Illaoi will have no mobility ability left to cross a wall.
Illaoi.fight: Prepare graves with Yorick Q Last Rites before a fight. After dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist immediately after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down to slow her and gain movement speed, then close in and fight.
Illaoi.laning: In the early game, clear the wave on your side to build graves and manage your health with Yorick Q Last Rites. Stay away from walls and Illaoi's tentacles, and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don't force an approach.
Illaoi.phase: Once you have your items in the mid-to-late game, pressure the lane and turret from a side lane.

Riven.combo: Then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites, and continue with basic attacks. If Riven Q Broken Wings or Riven E Valor is still available, she can cross walls, so don’t force this sequence.
Riven.build: Riven deals physical damage, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build, and get health to prepare for her finishing damage.
Riven.escape: The moment after Riven has fully spent Riven Q Broken Wings on minions is your chance to counterattack. Check whether Riven E Valor is down too, then close in with Yorick E Mourning Mist and block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession. If Riven W Ki Burst is still available, she can stun you after you close in, so approach carefully.
Riven.fight: Look for the moment Riven steps forward to last-hit or uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Build graves ahead of time, and approach only after landing Yorick E Mourning Mist so you can trade with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t close in if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Riven.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and maintain enough distance to respond to Riven’s dashes. If Riven pushes the wave and roams, pressure the turret.
Riven.phase: In the mid to late game, pressure lanes on the side. It is better to avoid standoffs with five players grouped together.
Riven.teamfight: Prepare graves and Mist Walkers before the fight, and don’t dive deep into the back line. Use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line, while keeping in mind that Riven can cross walls if Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available. Engage after Riven’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and attach Mist Walkers to the main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist.
Riven.watch: If Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor to close in repeatedly, Yorick has no way to escape and is likely to keep taking hits. When health has been significantly depleted, be especially careful of the finishing damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile.

Yone.escape: Look to engage after Yone’s tornado Q stacks disappear and Yone E Soul Unbound is down. Your chance to block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession is especially good before Yone R Fate Sealed comes off cooldown. When Yone enters in spirit form, manage your health with the extra damage on his return in mind; if the trade is unfavorable, move out of range before he returns.
Yone.build: Get movement speed first so you have room to walk out of Yone’s telegraphed attack range. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both resistances instead of focusing on one. Be careful about building only health, since Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health.
Yone.combo: From a position where you have graves, place Yorick W Dark Procession toward Yone’s escape path first, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist before chaining Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack into a regular attack. Yone can cross walls with Yone Q Mortal Steel, Yone E Soul Unbound, or Yone R Fate Sealed, so don’t assume Yorick W Dark Procession will stop his escape if he still has mobility available.
Yone.fight: When Yone steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use the slow and movement speed boost to land Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack. Don’t approach if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, and keep your distance while Yone’s tornado Q is ready.
Yone.laning: Build graves by clearing the wave on your side, and look for a chance to punish Yone when he steps forward to last-hit after you learn Yorick E Mourning Mist. If Yone pushes the lane and roams, turn that into an advantage by pressuring the turret.
Yone.phase: In the mid and late game, take advantage of Yorick’s ability to pressure a side lane alone and avoid standoffs with five players grouped together.
Yone.teamfight: Prepare graves and Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team’s backline. Keep your distance from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and check your position in the formation since Yone R Fate Sealed can follow the rearmost champion deep into your team. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your team, hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and attack the target struck by the Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles alongside her.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, watch for his tornado engage and keep your distance until the stacks disappear. If he follows up with Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed, Yorick can easily take a string of hits with no way out, so don’t approach relying only on Yorick W Dark Procession while Yone still has mobility available.

Quinn.fight: Start a trade just after Quinn E Vault is down or when your jungler arrives. When Quinn steps forward to last-hit, mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use the movement speed to close in and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t chase if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Quinn.laning: In the early game, don’t force fights within Quinn’s range; preserve your health and collect CS. Keep the wave on your side to build graves with Yorick P Shepherd of Souls, and stand behind the minion line so you can dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault. If Quinn roams, warn your allies ahead of time, then stay in lane and gain an advantage by pressuring the turret.
Quinn.build: Build armor first. Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault all deal physical damage, so armor is more effective than magic resistance.
Quinn.combo: Once Quinn E Vault is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in Quinn’s escape path first. Then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, followed by an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and another basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby, recast Yorick Q Last Rites after using the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Quinn.escape: Your opening to engage is right after Quinn E Vault is down. Block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession then, and close the gap by landing Yorick E Mourning Mist. Don’t engage if Quinn E Vault is still available or Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Quinn.phase: Yorick is strong at split pushing in the mid to late game, but watch for Quinn’s roams with Quinn R Behind Enemy Lines and secure vision if you lose track of her.
Quinn.teamfight: Before the fight, raise Mist Walkers from graves prepared with Yorick P Shepherd of Souls. Use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line, and engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally. If Quinn flanks, mark her with Yorick E Mourning Mist to attach Mist Walkers, and focus the target attacked by the Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Quinn.watch: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move outside Quinn’s basic attack range to let the mark expire. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line, and don’t cast Yorick E Mourning Mist while your vision is reduced. While Quinn E Vault is available, she can escape over Yorick W Dark Procession, so don’t force an approach.

Aurora.phase: In the mid to late game, once you have your items, push a side lane to create an advantage, but don’t force a team fight when all five enemies group up to contest.
Aurora.build: Complete one core item first, then slot in Executioner's Calling if Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing is a problem. Aurora deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor, and avoid stacking only health because of her max-health damage.
Aurora.combo: Read Aurora’s escape path and place Yorick W Dark Procession first, then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist before following with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and a regular basic attack. While Aurora W Across the Veil has her hidden, wait briefly and attack where she reappears. If there are enough graves nearby, use the empowered attack, then recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers.
Aurora.escape: Even after Aurora uses E The Weirding to create distance, check whether Aurora W Across the Veil and R Between Worlds are still available before going in. In particular, before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up, use the window when W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are also down to block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession.
Aurora.fight: When Aurora steps forward to last-hit, if you have graves ready, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then close in using the slow and movement speed. If Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, or R Between Worlds is still available, she can escape over Yorick W Dark Procession, so check her mobility before engaging.
Aurora.laning: When Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable, keep your distance behind minions. If Aurora pushes the lane and roams, pressure the turret.
Aurora.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a team fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, hit the main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and attack the target Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist is hitting. If Aurora enters with a leap and fails to kill anyone, seize that opportunity.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns, based on your missing health, so don’t try to tank the curse when your health is low. If cursed, step out of the line between Aurora and yourself to reduce the second hit. If you can’t retreat before Aurora R Between Worlds opens, account for the slow when leaving the zone and decide whether to fight.

Kayle.build: After completing your first core item, fit in Executioner's Calling to counter the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Build magic resistance to defend against Kayle’s primary damage. It’s also important to avoid direct hits from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which reduces your magic resistance.
Kayle.watch: Avoid direct hits from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces your armor and magic resistance. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on your missing health. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t unload your damage. Block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and wait for her invulnerability to end.
Kayle.combo: When you have a kill opportunity, place Yorick W Dark Procession on Kayle’s escape route first, then apply the mark and slow with Yorick E Mourning Mist and follow with an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack and a basic attack. If you have enough graves ready, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and delay your damage.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility, so when she steps forward to last-hit, hitting her with Yorick E Mourning Mist is an opportunity to engage. She can escape with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing, so place Yorick W Dark Procession on her escape route before closing in. If Kayle R Divine Judgment has already been used, it’s a good time to start a fight without waiting out her invulnerability.
Kayle.fight: Hit Kayle with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow her and gain movement speed, then close in and attack with Yorick Q Last Rites.
Kayle.laning: Clear the wave close to Yorick to build graves, and manage your health with Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t force an approach when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable. If Kayle pushes the lane and leaves, gain an advantage by pressuring her turret.
Kayle.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Find a route to reach Kayle from the flank or out of vision so she can’t keep attacking from the back, and time your entry with your team’s crowd control. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and attack again after the invulnerability ends.

Sett.fight: When Sett steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then trade with Yorick Q Last Rites. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t engage. After dealing damage, create some distance and wait for Sett W Haymaker’s Grit to fade.
Sett.build: Build armor first to reduce Sett’s main damage. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, reducing attack speed is also effective. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on maximum health, and the center true damage from Sett W Haymaker can’t be reduced with resistances, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: If Sett R The Show Stopper is down and graves are ready, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path first, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and another basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby, recast Yorick Q Last Rites after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Sett.escape: While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, you have a chance to trap him with Yorick W Dark Procession. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, you can engage without worrying about its stun after landing Yorick E Mourning Mist. While both abilities are available, keep your distance since Yorick has no way to escape on his own.
Sett.laning: Clear the wave close to Yorick to build graves, and start a trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist when Sett steps forward to last-hit. Keep your distance while Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable.
Sett.phase: In the mid to late game, pressure the side lanes, and don’t force an engage when both teams are grouped up.
Sett.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before the fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after Sett’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and land Yorick E Mourning Mist on the enemy’s main damage dealer to attach Mist Walkers. Focus the target attacked by the Mist Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so don’t stand on the opposite side of Sett from the minion wave. Sett W Haymaker becomes dangerous right after Sett takes a lot of damage, so deal your damage and back away; if you can’t dodge it, move sideways out of the center of its aim. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it grabs you, so don’t force an approach while his ultimate is available.

Aatrox.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. Yorick’s main physical damage is easily blocked by Aatrox’s high armor, so add penetration and make use of the max-health damage from Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles. After completing one core item, slot in Executioner's Calling to counter Aatrox’s healing.
Aatrox.combo: Right after Aatrox uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and follow with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and more basic attacks. If you have enough graves, recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers too.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is used is your window to engage. If you block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession, Aatrox will struggle to cross the wall. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains has hit you or you’re positioned to be caught by the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, get out of danger before engaging.
Aatrox.fight: Trade when Aatrox steps forward to last-hit or just after he uses Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance’s empowered basic attack on a minion. First hit with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then close in with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t force your way in.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, farm without giving up a kill, and clear the wave on your side to build graves. Once you have enough graves, you can use Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack, then recast it to raise Mist Walkers. When you see Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, dodge the blade’s edge, and keep your distance when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable.
Aatrox.phase: In the mid to late game, once you have your items, pressure a side lane, but avoid dueling while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.teamfight: Before a team fight, prepare Mist Walkers with graves, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your back line. Engage after Aatrox’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and hit the enemy’s main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send Mist Walkers after them. Attack the target marked by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist together with her to deal additional max-health damage.
Aatrox.watch: The main damage and knock-up from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade are dangerous, so watch the cast and dodge outside the blade’s edge or toward its inner area. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately without hesitating over which way to go, before it pulls you in. Aatrox R World Ender greatly increases his healing, so avoid dueling and keep your distance until it expires.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first to mitigate Akali’s main damage, and get enough health to avoid easily falling into Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range. Also get movement speed to help you dodge her telegraphed area attacks.
Akali.combo: When Akali’s mobility is down and you can block her escape, place Yorick W Dark Procession first in the direction she would retreat. Then slow and mark her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and follow with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and more basic attacks. If you have enough graves, use the empowered attack, then recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers. If Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist is present, attack the target she is hitting.
Akali.escape: Don’t engage just because one of Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution is down. In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up, wait for a window when her other mobility is also down, then block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and engage.
Akali.fight: When Akali steps forward to last-hit or comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to engage, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist and close in. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t chase recklessly just to land Yorick Q Last Rites’ basic attack. If you’ve built graves ahead of time, Mist Walkers will also rush the marked target when you fight.
Akali.laning: When Akali steps forward to last-hit, start the trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and prioritize dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip’s shuriken. If Akali pushes the lane and roams, pressure the turret to turn that into an advantage.
Akali.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a team fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your back line. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, hit the main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and attack the target Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist is hitting.

Camille.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, W Tactical Sweep, and E Hookshot. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage can’t be reduced by armor, and stacking only health increases the damage from Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Camille W Tactical Sweep’s healing is a problem, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Camille.combo: After Camille E Hookshot and R The Hextech Ultimatum are down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in her escape path, then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist before following with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and a basic attack. If you have enough graves, recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers.
Camille.escape: Even if Camille E Hookshot is down, don’t go deep if Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available. In particular, before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, wait for a window when Camille E Hookshot is also down, then block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and engage.
Camille.fight: Build graves ahead of time, and when Camille steps forward to last-hit, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist and close in. Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates; once the shield has been removed, hit her with Yorick Q Last Rites. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t force a chase.
Camille.laning: Clear the wave on your side and position away from walls to watch for Camille E Hookshot’s engage. If Camille pushes the lane and leaves, Yorick can gain an advantage by pressuring the turret.
Camille.phase: Camille has weak, slow wave clear before her first core item, so take control of the lane and pressure her farming before then. Yorick’s side lane pressure gets strong in the mid to late game, but Camille can also take side lane turrets quickly, so don’t leave the lane unattended.
Camille.teamfight: Prepare graves and Mist Walkers before a team fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and hit the main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Attack the target Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist is hitting to make use of the additional max-health damage.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot lets her engage from range using a wall and then stun you, so stay away from walls. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s second empowered basic attack deals some true damage, so create distance while she prepares it. Don’t use your response as Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum begins; if you’re trapped, wait out its duration, then counterattack.

Chogath.build: After completing one core item, slot in Executioner's Calling to reduce Cho'Gath P Carnivore’s healing. Build magic resistance against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes, and consider tenacity since Yorick has no mobility. Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage, so resistances can’t block it.
Chogath.combo: Place Yorick W Dark Procession first toward Cho'Gath’s escape path, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Follow with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and a basic attack. If you have enough graves nearby, use the empowered attack, then recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility, so the moment after Cho'Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave or misses is your chance to engage. Hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to close in, then place Yorick W Dark Procession in the direction he would retreat. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, walk out of the dangerous area first instead of trying to cast an ability.
Chogath.fight: Build graves ahead of time, and when Cho'Gath steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and close in. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t chase, and walk to the side to dodge when you see the indicator for Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Look for an opportunity to block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession just after Cho'Gath uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.laning: Stand to the side of the line Cho'Gath’s basic attacks follow and the line behind minions to avoid being hit by Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes’ poke too. Limit the time Cho'Gath has to build stacks, but don’t force a fight when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable or you have no graves.
Chogath.phase: Pressure a side lane in the mid to late game, but don’t give Cho'Gath a kill as his stacks make him stronger over time.
Chogath.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a team fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after Cho'Gath Q Rupture and W Feral Scream have been used on an ally, and hit the enemy’s main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Attack the target marked by the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles together with her.
Chogath.watch: When you see the indicator beneath you for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, immediately walk to the side to dodge it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, it’s hard to dodge the Cho'Gath Q Rupture that follows, so don’t start a trade head-on. If your health is at half or below, keep your distance and watch out for Cho'Gath R Feast’s true damage and the increased range from its stacks.

Darius.build: Build armor first to mitigate Darius P Hemorrhage, Q Decimate, and W Crippling Strike. Armor has limited effect against Darius E Apprehend’s penetration and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine, so also build health. After completing one core item, slot in Executioner's Calling to reduce Darius Q Decimate’s healing.
Darius.combo: Once you’ve prepared graves and Darius E Apprehend is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession first in Darius’s escape path. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and follow with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and a basic attack. If you’ve used the empowered attack and have enough graves nearby, recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers.
Darius.escape: At this point, use Yorick W Dark Procession to block his escape, then hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to close in. If Darius R Noxian Guillotine is still available, account for the fact that Darius can jump over Yorick W Dark Procession.
Darius.fight: Trade briefly when Darius E Apprehend is down and you have no stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage on you. Hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then land Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and back off. If the fight drags on and Hemorrhage stacks build up, immediately create distance.
Darius.laning: Look for a chance to poke when Darius steps forward to last-hit or just after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions, but stay outside Darius E Apprehend’s range if it’s still available. Use Yorick Q Last Rites to manage your CS and health, and pressure the turret if Darius roams.
Darius.phase: Early on, Yorick has few ways to trade and Darius is strong in chaotic fights, so focus on farming and preparing graves. In the mid to late game, once you have your items, pressure a side lane, but avoid extended fights with Darius.
Darius.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a team fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after crowd control such as Darius E Apprehend has been used on an ally, and hit the enemy’s main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send Mist Walkers after them. Attack the target Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles’ Maiden of the Mist is hitting, and if several Hemorrhage stacks build up, back off to prevent Darius R Noxian Guillotine from getting a kill and resetting.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, Darius W Crippling Strike and Darius Q Decimate follow, so poke from outside E’s range. If stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage build up, create distance to break off the fight. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the axe’s blade range or hug him closely. If health has dropped while Hemorrhage is stacked, get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine’s range, as it deals true damage.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first because Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s main damage is physical. After completing your first core item, slot in Executioner's Calling to counter Dr. Mundo’s strong healing. Keep Grievous Wounds up with Yorick’s basic attacks and Mist Walkers.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, use Yorick W Dark Procession to trigger it first, then step on the dropped canister. When you engage afterward, place Yorick W Dark Procession in Dr. Mundo’s escape path, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist before following with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack and a basic attack. If you have enough graves, use the empowered attack, then recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so approach after Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion or misses. Once Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases has been triggered and Yorick E Mourning Mist hits, block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and engage. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don’t spend time chasing him.
DrMundo.fight: Before a fight, prepare graves with Yorick Q Last Rites, and hit Dr. Mundo with Yorick E Mourning Mist when he steps forward to last-hit. Close in using the slow and movement speed, then land Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered basic attack. Don’t force your way in if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or you have no graves in the area.
DrMundo.laning: Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions. After trading, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops as you retreat to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction. If Dr. Mundo pushes the lane and leaves, pressure the turret.
DrMundo.phase: In the mid to late game, once you have your items, pressure a side lane, but don’t spend time trying to kill Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available.
DrMundo.teamfight: Raise Mist Walkers just before a team fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, hit the main damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and send Mist Walkers after them. Attack the target marked by the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles together with her.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target and deals damage based on current health, so especially when your health is high, stand behind minions. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, he can ignore the first immobilizing effect from Yorick W Dark Procession. Don’t force a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active; account for its healing and movement speed increase.

Gangplank.build: Gangplank Q Parrrley can easily wear down your health, so prioritize armor from the start of lane. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances cannot stop, so you must withstand them with your health pool. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Gangplank.combo: Prepare graves in advance, then mark and slow Gangplank with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Close in and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites, followed by more basic attacks. When looking for a kill, wait until Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape route, then follow up with Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick Q Last Rites.
Gangplank.escape: Engage just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, before it ages. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, Yorick W Dark Procession is good for blocking his escape route. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, but delay your engage if there is an aged keg nearby.
Gangplank.fight: Hit Gangplank with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then close in and trade with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Your opportunity comes just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed; back off if there is an aged keg nearby. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don't force an approach.
Gangplank.laning: Start a trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist when Gangplank steps forward to last-hit. When Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable, wait behind your minions. If Gangplank pushes the wave and roams, pressure the turret.
Gangplank.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on an ally, and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles, and time objective fights around whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg becomes more dangerous as it ages, so avoid areas near an aged keg or where two kegs overlap. If you can destroy a keg from outside its explosion range, destroy it yourself.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice cannot be reduced by resistances, so account for its damage when deciding whether your health pool can withstand it. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack is spent and Garen W Courage's brief shield window has passed, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape route first. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites followed by more basic attacks. If you have enough graves, spend the empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites, then press it again to awaken the Mist Walkers.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility ability, so once the silence from Garen Q Decisive Strike is no longer available, you have an opportunity to block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and engage. If Garen W Courage has just been activated, place Yorick W Dark Procession after its brief shield and tenacity have worn off.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly right after Garen uses Garen Q Decisive Strike on a minion or spends his empowered attack. From a spot where you have prepared graves, hit Garen with Yorick E Mourning Mist, close in, and strike with Yorick Q Last Rites. Back off when Garen E Judgment starts. Immediately after Garen W Courage is activated, delay Yorick W Dark Procession and your follow-up attacks by half a beat.
Garen.laning: Poke Garen with Yorick E Mourning Mist when he steps forward to last-hit, and pressure him from the start to deny him opportunities to build growth stacks on Garen W Courage. If you push the lane hard, you may be exposed to a jungle gank, so save Yorick W Dark Procession.
Garen.phase: Once you have your items in the mid-to-late game, use side lane pressure. Stacks on Garen W Courage remain permanently, so he can become harder to deal with over time; it's best to slow his growth from the start.
Garen.teamfight: Prepare graves and Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or guard the area behind your allies. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on an ally, and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike silences you, making it hard to fight back, so don't approach while he has the empowered attack ready. When Garen E Judgment starts, don't stay in the fight for long; move out of its spin range. If your health is below half, beware Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health, and stay out of range.

Gnar.build: Prioritize armor against Gnar's main damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health. Yorick has no mobility ability, so consider tenacity against the stun from Gnar R GNAR!.
Gnar.combo: Prepare graves nearby, then bait out Gnar E Hop / Crunch. Place Yorick W Dark Procession in the direction Gnar would retreat, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites, followed by more basic attacks.
Gnar.escape: Look to engage just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down. If Gnar is still in Mega form with Gnar R GNAR! available, avoid angles where he can knock you into a wall, and engage just after he returns to Mini form.
Gnar.fight: When Gnar steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then trade with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used, block his escape route with Yorick W Dark Procession and close in. Back off just after he transforms into Mega Gnar, and look for an opening just after he returns to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and manage your health with Yorick Q Last Rites. When Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable, don't force an approach through Mini Gnar's ranged poke.
Gnar.phase: Once you have your items in the mid-to-late game, pressure a side lane, but don't force an engage when all five enemies are grouped up for a standoff.
Gnar.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or guard the area behind your allies. Be mindful of Gnar R GNAR! and avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on an ally, hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and attack the same target as the Maiden summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Gnar.watch: Avoid the slow from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, and dodge Mini Gnar's boomerang on its return path as well. Avoid direct fights when Gnar's Rage is building and his transformation is near. Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one.

Gwen.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Gwen's main damage, and build armor as well to account for her basic attack damage. The true damage in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! cannot be stopped by resistances, so dodge it with positioning. If the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item, and add penetration against Gwen's high armor.
Gwen.combo: If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in her escape route, then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. If you have enough graves nearby, spend the empowered basic attack, then press Yorick Q Last Rites again to awaken the Mist Walkers. Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles' Maiden of the Mist marks a target; Yorick also attacks that target to deal bonus damage based on its maximum health.
Gwen.escape: Just after baiting out Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is Yorick's chance to engage. When Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down on the side without minions, block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is still available, don't go deep relying only on Yorick W Dark Procession.
Gwen.fight: Build graves in advance. When Gwen steps forward to last-hit, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist and close in. Don't engage when Gwen Q Snip Snip! has full stacks, and start a fight just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don't chase recklessly to land Yorick Q Last Rites.
Gwen.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and start a trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist when Gwen steps forward. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash gets a large cooldown refund if it hits something, so don't try to catch her recklessly where there are lots of minions.
Gwen.phase: There are opportunities to trade before the stacks build up. Once you have your items in the mid-to-late game, pressure a side lane, and don't force a fight when all five enemies are grouped up for a standoff.
Gwen.teamfight: Awaken the Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team's backline. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on an ally, and use Yorick E Mourning Mist to attach the Mist Walkers to a key damage dealer. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! while attacking the same target as the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so move to the side to avoid the center when she uses it. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is available, she can cross Yorick W Dark Procession. Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist cannot be targeted from outside the mist, so wait for it to end or go inside.

Irelia.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Her basic attacks and attack speed are also central to her damage, so an option that reduces attack speed can help. Fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item to counter the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.combo: After confirming Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in her escape route. Then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites followed by more basic attacks. If you have enough graves nearby, press Q again to raise the Mist Walkers.
Irelia.escape: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is available, she can cross Yorick W Dark Procession, so just after she uses Q is your chance to trap and engage with W. Engage after Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is down, and hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist to use its slow and movement speed increase.
Irelia.fight: Build graves in advance. When Irelia steps forward to last-hit, hit her with Yorick E Mourning Mist and close in. If it misses, don't approach. Just after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, block her escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and fight.
Irelia.phase: Once you have your items in the mid-to-late game, focus on side lane pressure, and don't force a fight when all five enemies are grouped up for a standoff.
Irelia.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a passage and cut off Irelia's approach. Since Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a big impact on team fights, mark an engaging Irelia with Yorick E Mourning Mist to focus the Mist Walkers on her. Yorick should protect his team's backline instead of diving the enemy backline, and attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain in by dashing to low-health minions, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you get trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Escaping through the barrier deals extra damage and applies a strong slow.

Jax.build: Jax's basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, so consider a defensive item that reduces attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance.
Jax.combo: After confirming Jax Q Leap Strike is down and Jax E Counter Strike has ended, place Yorick W Dark Procession toward his escape route. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and a basic attack.
Jax.escape: Just after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your chance to block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and engage. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, wait outside its stun range and engage after it ends.
Jax.fight: When Jax steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then close in. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move outside its stun range; after Counter Strike ends, trade with Yorick Q Last Rites.
Jax.laning: Look for Jax's last-hit animation when Yorick E Mourning Mist is ready, but pressure him with your jungler while Counter Strike is down.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don't group up; respond after the stun ends. Before a fight, Yorick should awaken the Mist Walkers and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a passage or protect his team's backline. Using W after Jax Q Leap Strike is down lets you block Jax's path more reliably.
Jax.watch: If Jax Q Leap Strike is available, he can cross Yorick W Dark Procession, so use W to block his escape after he uses his leap.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Magic resistance cannot stop the physical damage from Jayce Q Shock Blast, and Jayce R Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer can reduce your resistances, so also get movement speed to dodge the attacks you can see coming.
Jayce.combo: After Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in Jayce's escape route first. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites followed by more basic attacks.
Jayce.escape: Just after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is your chance to close the distance. If Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback is down too, block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to engage.
Jayce.fight: When Jayce steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then trade with Yorick Q Last Rites. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don't chase. Treat the moment after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down as your main chance to engage.
Jayce.laning: In the early game, farm defensively and clear the wave close to Yorick to build graves. Move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast, and if health has dropped substantially, clear the lane, then head back. If Jayce pushes the lane and leaves, pressure the turret.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so focus on farming and preparing graves instead of forcing trades. In the late game, Yorick has less impact when all five enemies are grouped up for a standoff, so use side lane pressure.
Jayce.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team's backline. Engage after the enemy's crowd control has been used on an ally. If Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, mark Jayce with Yorick E Mourning Mist so the Mist Walkers attach to him. Attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce is holding the cannon, watch for Jayce Q Shock Blast after Jayce E Acceleration Gate, and move to the side out of its firing line as soon as you see the gate. When he is holding the hammer, he can leap with Jayce Q To the Skies! and knock you away with Jayce E Thundering Blow, so watch for both abilities.

Kennen.build: Yorick has no mobility, so prioritize tenacity to prepare for the stun from Kennen P Mark of the Storm. Then build magic resistance against Kennen’s magic damage.
Kennen.combo: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession on his escape route first. Follow with Yorick E Mourning Mist to apply the mark and slow, then land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack and a follow-up basic attack.
Kennen.escape: If Kennen E Lightning Rush is still available, he can cross Yorick W Dark Procession, so wait until he uses it before engaging. When Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, don’t go in; back off briefly and wait for the stacks to disappear.
Kennen.fight: When Kennen steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him, gain movement speed, and approach. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t overextend to land a Yorick Q Last Rites basic attack.
Kennen.laning: Early on, farm behind minions to block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken. Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and manage your health with Yorick Q Last Rites. If Kennen pushes the lane and leaves, pressure his turret.
Kennen.phase: In the mid to late game, pressure a side lane, but don’t force an engage when all five enemies are grouped up for a standoff.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and use vision to track Kennen’s entry path. Awaken the Mist Walkers ahead of time, then use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a passage or protect your team’s back line. Go in after the enemy has used crowd control on an ally, and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist.
Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so stand behind minions. When Kennen P Mark of the Storm has stacked twice, back off to avoid the third hit. In teamfights, spread out from your allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.

Kled.build: Build armor first against Kled’s main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting. Yorick has no mobility to escape on his own, so consider prioritizing tenacity if repeated crowd control is a problem. Reducing attack speed is also useful to delay Kled W Violent Tendencies’ four basic attacks.
Kled.combo: After Kled’s dash abilities are down, place Yorick W Dark Procession on his escape route, then apply the mark and slow with Yorick E Mourning Mist and land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack. If there are enough graves nearby, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers. If Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available, he can escape over the wall.
Kled.escape: Look for an engage after both Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down. If you’ve also avoided the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and fight. If only one of Kled’s dash abilities is down, don’t go in too soon; he can cross the wall with the other.
Kled.fight: When Kled steps forward to last-hit, hit him first with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use the slow and movement speed to land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t chase. If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, create distance before he lands all four basic attacks, then trade again.
Kled.laning: Start trades with Yorick E Mourning Mist only when Kled steps forward, and don’t force an approach while Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable. After dismounting Kled, if his courage is about to fill, create distance. If you can pressure him, push him away so he can’t hit minions or turrets.
Kled.phase: Kled weakens after the laning phase and mid game, so get through the early game safely, then pressure from a side lane.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks because Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can come from out of vision. Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist so Mist Walkers attach to them.
Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, immediately create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, keep trades short so you don’t take the fourth basic attack, which deals damage based on your maximum health. If both Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are still available, he can cross Yorick W Dark Procession, so don’t close in relying only on the wall.

KSante.build: Add penetration to Yorick’s main physical damage to deal with K'Sante’s high armor. Build armor rather than magic resistance against K'Sante’s main damage, and use health against the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker. Tenacity can also be a priority since you’re vulnerable to follow-up hits after crowd control.
KSante.combo: When K'Sante’s mobility is down and you can see his escape route, place Yorick W Dark Procession there first. Follow with Yorick E Mourning Mist to apply the mark and slow, then approach and land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack and a basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
KSante.escape: Don’t go in just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down; also check K'Sante E Footwork and R All Out. Look for a window before K'Sante R All Out comes back, after his remaining mobility and crowd control are down. Hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and go in. If you block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession, it will be hard for him to get away.
KSante.fight: Prepare graves in your side of the wave. When K'Sante steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and then approach. If K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, don’t commit your damage; avoid the dash’s direction. After K'Sante R All Out is activated and his armor is reduced, focus your damage with Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles, but don’t fight him alone for long.
KSante.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and manage your health with Yorick Q Last Rites. Keep your distance when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable. If K'Sante pushes the lane and leaves, pressure his turret.
KSante.phase: In the mid to late game, pressure a side lane instead of fighting K'Sante, who has built defensive items, head-on for long.
KSante.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after K'Sante uses his crowd control on an ally, then send Mist Walkers to a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. If K'Sante R All Out is active and his armor is lower, attack with your team, but don’t let him hit several people while healing.
KSante.watch: K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes stacks even when he hits minions, so move out of range when his shockwave is ready. K'Sante W Path Maker reduces damage taken and grants unstoppable status while charging, so sidestep to avoid the dash. Don’t stand with your back to a wall when hit by K'Sante R All Out, or you may be knocked through terrain.

Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite’s main damage from Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Malphite W Thunderclap deals physical damage, so magic resistance alone won’t block it. To attack through Malphite’s high armor, use the percent maximum health damage from Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles instead of relying on armor penetration.
Malphite.combo: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then, from a spot with graves, place Yorick W Dark Procession on Malphite’s escape route. Follow with Yorick E Mourning Mist to apply the mark and slow, then approach and land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack and a follow-up basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby and you’ve used the empowered attack, use Yorick Q Last Rites again to raise Mist Walkers.
Malphite.escape: Malphite has no way to cross Yorick W Dark Procession here, so block his escape and close in after hitting him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Delay your engage immediately after being slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Malphite.fight: Start trading only after breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, when you can damage his actual health. When Malphite steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then close in and use Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t force an engage if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or you’ve been hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard.
Malphite.laning: If Malphite pushes the lane and leaves, pressure his turret.
Malphite.phase: In the mid to late game, once you have your items, prepare graves and the Maiden of the Mist to pressure a side lane.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock several of you up at once, and engage after that ability is down. Wake Mist Walkers before a fight, then use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Hit an enemy key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and attack the target marked by the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles alongside her.
Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it hard to close in even if you hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, so don’t start a damage trade immediately after being hit. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t be stopped by Yorick W Dark Procession, so when you can’t see Malphite, don’t give him an engage angle near a wall or brush.

Mordekaiser.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, and Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Build armor as well to account for his basic attack damage, but avoid relying on a large amount of health alone because Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on maximum health. After completing one core item, fit in Executioner's Calling to counter the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible.
Mordekaiser.combo: For a standard trade, apply the mark and slow with Yorick E Mourning Mist, land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack, then back off. When you have a kill opportunity, place Yorick W Dark Procession on Mordekaiser’s escape route first, then follow with Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick Q Last Rites. Attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles to deal extra damage.
Mordekaiser.escape: Look for an engage after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses. Mordekaiser has no mobility, so hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to approach, then block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession. However, avoid engaging alone within range of Mordekaiser R Realm of Death if it’s ready.
Mordekaiser.fight: When Mordekaiser steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then trade briefly with Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t approach if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses. Right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield activates, don’t commit your damage; focus your attacks after the shield wears down or converts into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and start a trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist when Mordekaiser steps forward to last-hit. Keep your distance in front of him, where Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can easily hit you, and don’t start a fight while Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable.
Mordekaiser.phase: Side lane pressure is Yorick’s strength in the mid to late game, but don’t start a solo duel while Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Spread out from your allies in front of Mordekaiser so several of you aren’t pulled in by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Avoid positions where Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can trap you alone, then engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to attach Mist Walkers.
Mordekaiser.watch: If you’re pulled by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, you’re likely to be hit next by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, so keep your distance in front of him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade briefly and back off. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don’t enter its range alone and risk a duel where you can’t get help from allies.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus’s main damage from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands. Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about relying on a large amount of health alone.
Nasus.combo: Place Yorick W Dark Procession on Nasus’s escape route first, then apply the mark and slow with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Close in and follow with an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack and a basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Nasus.escape: Engage after Nasus W Wither is down, when Nasus steps forward to last-hit. Nasus has no way to create distance other than Flash, so hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession.
Nasus.fight: Don’t force an approach if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Don’t push the lane all the way to Nasus’s turret; clear minions on your side to build graves. Pressure Nasus when he steps forward to last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, leaving him less room to stack it. If the lane comes toward your side, call for a jungle gank and block Nasus’s escape with Yorick W Dark Procession.
Nasus.phase: Pressure from a side lane in the mid to late game, but keep in mind that Nasus continues stacking Nasus Q Siphoning Strike and becomes harder to deal with as the game goes on.
Nasus.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Don’t take Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance and wait out its duration. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then hit an enemy key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist so Mist Walkers attach to them.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so don’t get caught alone within its range. Your armor is reduced while you’re on Nasus E Spirit Fire, so move out of the area. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, his health and defenses are higher; avoid fighting and wait out its duration unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so build health as well. You can also reduce attack speed to account for the damage he deals through basic attacks.
Olaf.combo: When Olaf R Ragnarok has ended and Olaf steps forward, place Yorick W Dark Procession on his escape route first. Follow with Yorick E Mourning Mist to apply the mark and slow, then land an empowered Yorick Q Last Rites attack and a basic attack. If you have enough graves, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Olaf.escape: Look for an engage when Olaf Q Undertow misses, making it hard for him to recover his axe, and Olaf R Ragnarok has ended. Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and go in.
Olaf.fight: Start a damage trade when Olaf steps forward to last-hit and you can hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Apply the mark and slow, then land an empowered attack with Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t approach if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses. Olaf gets stronger as his health drops, so don’t chase unless you’re sure you can finish him.
Olaf.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and move away from the direction Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands. If Olaf pushes the lane and leaves, gain an advantage by pressuring his turret.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so survive while building graves without giving him a kill. In the mid to late game, pressure a side lane and don’t stay long in a standoff with five players grouped together.
Olaf.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Keep your distance while Olaf R Ragnarok is active, then restrict his movement with Yorick W Dark Procession after it ends. When you engage, hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, helping him approach. Move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up, and beware the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing; create distance when your health is low. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t try to stop him with Yorick W Dark Procession. Back off so Olaf’s attacks don’t hit you and extend its duration.

Ornn.build: Getting caught by Ornn W Bellows Breath and the crowd control that follows is dangerous, so as Yorick, who has no mobility ability, consider tenacity before resistances. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t focus on only one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: After Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in Ornn’s escape path first. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, followed by an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and another basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby, recast Yorick Q Last Rites after the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Ornn.escape: Yorick has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t push deep while Ornn still has crowd control available. If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, Ornn can still escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession after both mobility tools are down. In particular, look for an opening before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back.
Ornn.fight: When Ornn steps forward to last-hit, land Yorick E Mourning Mist first to slow him and gain movement speed, then follow with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t close in. Keep your distance if Ornn W Bellows Breath has made you Brittle or Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available.
Ornn.laning: Once you have Yorick E Mourning Mist, look for the moment Ornn steps up to last-hit, but don’t force an approach while E is unavailable. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, approach and attack to interrupt him. If he pushes the wave and leaves, pressure the turret.
Ornn.phase: Build your lead in lane and against the turret before Ornn’s items and his allies’ Masterwork upgrades accumulate.
Ornn.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers from graves before the fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Move out of the straight line between the ram from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn, and engage after Ornn’s crowd control has been used on an ally. Land Yorick E Mourning Mist on the enemy’s main damage dealer, and focus the target attacked by the Maiden summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Ornn.watch: Near the pillar created by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or a terrain wall, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up, so back toward open ground. If Ornn W Bellows Breath’s final burst makes you Brittle, don’t move forward; keep your distance until it ends. When you see Ornn R Call of the Forge God, dodge the ram to the side and move out of the straight line where Ornn can send it back.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first because Pantheon’s main damage is physical. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has penetration, so don’t rely on stacking health or armor alone. Yorick’s physical damage is easily blocked by Pantheon’s high armor, so include penetration in your damage build.
Pantheon.combo: Prepare graves with Yorick Q Last Rites before the fight. Place Yorick W Dark Procession toward Pantheon’s escape route, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist before chaining an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites into another basic attack. If Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon R Grand Starfall is still available, he can cross walls, so first check whether his escape tools are down.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and he can no longer use its stun and dash. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also still on cooldown, you have a chance to block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession. If only one mobility ability is down, he can still escape with the other, so don’t chase recklessly.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon steps up to last-hit, land Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then trade with Yorick Q Last Rites. Don’t close in if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or there are no graves nearby. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or angle in from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Clear the wave on your side to build graves, and manage your health and CS with Yorick Q Last Rites. If Pantheon pushes the wave and roams, turn that into an advantage by pressuring the turret.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off late game, while Yorick is strong when split pushing with items.
Pantheon.teamfight: Prepare graves and Mist Walkers before the fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and land Yorick E Mourning Mist on the main damage dealer. Attack the same target as the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles to deal additional damage based on the target’s maximum health.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon is strong in early head-on trades, and Pantheon W Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun that you can’t dodge once you’re in range. Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking damage from the front, don’t use Yorick Q Last Rites; wait for it to end.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone, and don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: If Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and you’ve read her escape route, place Yorick W Dark Procession behind Poppy first. Then mark and slow her with Yorick E Mourning Mist, followed by an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and another basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby and you’ve used the empowered attack, recast Yorick Q Last Rites to raise Mist Walkers.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down is your chance to close the gap. Using Yorick W Dark Procession then makes it harder for Poppy to escape. If Poppy is charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, first get out of her line of attack, then engage after the crowd control has been used.
Poppy.fight: Yorick has no ability to escape on his own, so only trade when Poppy steps forward. Land Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow her and gain movement speed, then follow with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, you can fight with her escape blocked by Yorick W Dark Procession.
Poppy.laning: Trade when Poppy steps forward to last-hit by landing Yorick E Mourning Mist, and keep your distance while this ability is unavailable. If Poppy P Iron Ambassador’s shield lands somewhere safe, step on it first to deny her the shield.
Poppy.phase: In the mid to late game, once you have items, focus on split pushing, but don’t rush to engage in a standoff with five players grouped together.
Poppy.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before the fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after Poppy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and land Yorick E Mourning Mist on the enemy’s main damage dealer to attach Mist Walkers. Focus the target attacked by the Maiden summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so stay in open ground instead of standing with your back to a wall. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second explosion. When you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move to the side out of her line of attack.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. The empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so position to dodge the dash instead of relying on armor alone. Fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing your first core item to counter the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, and you have a kill opportunity, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path first. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, followed by an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and another basic attack. If there are enough graves nearby, recast Yorick Q Last Rites after using the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Renekton.escape: Engage after Renekton has used Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage, putting the dash down, and has also used Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Then block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and close in by landing Yorick E Mourning Mist.
Renekton.fight: Build graves ahead of time and trade when Renekton’s Reign of Anger bar is empty. When Renekton steps up to last-hit, land Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then close in with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. If Renekton has just used Q, W, and E, his only remaining attack is a basic attack, so counterattack.
Renekton.laning: Harass Renekton with Yorick E Mourning Mist when he steps forward to hit minions and build Fury, but don’t stand in or behind the minion wave where it can set up Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Renekton pushes the wave and leaves, take advantage by pressuring the turret.
Renekton.phase: Renekton falls off in the mid to late game while Yorick’s split push gets stronger, so push the lane alone to build an advantage.
Renekton.teamfight: Raise Mist Walkers before the fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and land Yorick E Mourning Mist on the main damage dealer to send Mist Walkers after them. Focus the target marked by the Maiden summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Renekton.watch: If Renekton’s Reign of Anger bar is above or close to half, stay out of range to avoid the stun from an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice can hit minions to enable a second dash, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave.

Rumble.build: Choose magic resistance on your defensive items first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Once graves are ready and you can see Rumble’s escape route, place Yorick W Dark Procession first in the direction he would retreat.
