Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, followed by an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and another basic attack. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, focus your damage after it disappears.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the window to block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession comes after the movement speed and shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield are down. If you’re hit by the first charge of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don’t engage; create distance to dodge the second charge.
Rumble.fight: Build graves ahead of time and land Yorick E Mourning Mist when Rumble walks forward to last-hit, then close in. If E misses, don’t walk into Rumble Q Flamespitter range to land a Yorick Q Last Rites basic attack. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, wait briefly for the shield to disappear before trading.
Rumble.laning: Clear the wave on your side to prepare graves, and start a trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist only when Rumble steps forward. If Rumble pushes the wave and leaves, take advantage by pressuring the turret.
Rumble.phase: After learning Yorick E Mourning Mist, you can prepare graves and trade when Rumble steps forward.
Rumble.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before the fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow passage or protect your team’s back line. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on an ally, and land Yorick E Mourning Mist on the main damage dealer to attach Mist Walkers. Focus the target attacked by the Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter is dangerous while you’re close, so only trade when Rumble steps forward and don’t stay in range for long. If you’re hit by the first charge of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, immediately create distance before the second charge stacks another slow and magic resistance reduction. Watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer as well.

Shen.build: The source doesn't specify a particular starting item, so one can't be chosen. If building resistances, account for both the physical damage from Shen E Shadow Dash and the magic damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault, and prioritize tenacity to prepare for the taunt. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that stack only health.
Shen.combo: When Shen E Shadow Dash is down and Shen R Stand United is unavailable, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, approach, and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge becomes active, wait for it to end before using the empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is Yorick's opening to engage. If Shen R Stand United isn't back yet, block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession, then hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and close in. Keep in mind that Shen can escape over a wall if Shen E Shadow Dash or Shen R Stand United is available.
Shen.fight: When Shen steps forward to last-hit near graves you've prepared, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and approach. Look for an opening right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, but if Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, wait until it ends before landing an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites.
Shen.laning: After that, trade when you can hit Shen with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then push the lane to keep him occupied with CS. If Shen leaves with Shen R Stand United, alert your team and take advantage of the empty lane and turret.
Shen.phase: In the mid and late game, pressure a side lane, but alert your team when Shen uses Shen R Stand United to join allies elsewhere.
Shen.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers from graves before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team's backline. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Attack the target being hit by the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Shen.watch: Dodge Shen E Shadow Dash, because being taunted by it leaves you exposed to Shen Q Twilight Assault empowered attacks. Also move out of the way of the Spirit Blade's path back to Shen. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, don't use Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks.

Singed.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can get out of poisoned areas, then build magic resistance. Both Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling deal magic damage, so armor won't help against his damage. Singed E Fling also deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that stack only health.
Singed.combo: Prepare graves, then place Yorick W Dark Procession in Singed's escape path ahead of time. Follow with Yorick E Mourning Mist to mark and slow him, then get close and land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites followed by basic attacks. If there are enough graves nearby and you've spent the empowered attack, use Yorick Q Last Rites again to raise Mist Walkers.
Singed.escape: A good chance to close in is when Singed W Mega Adhesive hasn't been placed and Singed E Fling is down. Hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path to trap Singed if he tries to run away without a movement ability. Don't follow him in the direction covered by his poison.
Singed.fight: When Singed steps forward, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to gain its slow and movement speed, then trade with Yorick Q Last Rites. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don't force an approach. If Singed retreats while leaving poison behind, stop chasing unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure.
Singed.laning: Early on, clear the wave on your side to stack graves and use Yorick Q Last Rites to secure CS and health. If Singed pushes the lane and leaves, turn it into an advantage by pressuring his turret.
Singed.phase: In the mid and late game, pressure the lane and turret on a side lane, but don't chase Singed through his poison.
Singed.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight and use Yorick W Dark Procession to trap a charging Singed or block a narrow path. Attack Singed's allies during this time rather than chasing him to the end. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then mark a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send the Mist Walkers after them.
Singed.watch: Don't chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive to avoid being rooted by Singed E Fling there. When Singed R Insanity Potion is active, his poison applies Grievous Wounds, so don't rely solely on healing from Yorick Q Last Rites to stay alive.

Sion.build: Prioritize armor against the main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor can't block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer, so also focus on dodging Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that stack only health.
Sion.combo: If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path first, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and follow with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and basic attacks. If there are enough graves nearby, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after spending the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers. If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is available, don't expect Yorick W Dark Procession alone to trap him for long.
Sion.escape: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or bait him into using it early, then hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and engage. Blocking his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession makes it difficult for Sion to get away.
Sion.fight: When Sion steps forward to last-hit, hit him first with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use the slow and movement speed to land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Don't approach if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or you would be in a position where you can't dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash. Right after Sion activates Sion W Soul Furnace, focus damage on its shield and look for a chance to break it before it explodes.
Sion.laning: Early on, clear the wave on your side, use Yorick Q Last Rites to secure CS and health, and prepare graves for Yorick P Shepherd of Souls. Don't force a fight where there are no graves; look for chances to disrupt Sion's farming. If Sion pushes the lane and leaves, gain an advantage by pressuring his turret.
Sion.phase: In the mid and late game, pressure a side lane, but don't let Sion keep stacking CS uncontested.
Sion.teamfight: Before a fight, raise Mist Walkers from graves and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team's backline. Engage after crowd control such as Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught has been used on an ally. Hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send the Mist Walkers after them, and attack the target being hit by the Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash knocks you up and stuns you if charged for long, so move to the side when you see him charging it. Don't face Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side of its direction. Even after you take Sion down, Sion P Glory in Death lets him revive and attack, so reposition immediately.

Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that stack only health.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path first, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and basic attacks. If there are enough graves nearby, use Q again after spending the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Skarner.escape: The opening for Yorick to engage is immediately after you force Skarner to use his mobility tool, E Ixtal's Impact. At that moment, block Skarner's escape with Yorick W Dark Procession and approach after hitting him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. If Skarner R Impale is available, be careful about entering its short suppression range.
Skarner.fight: Yorick has no ability to escape on his own, so don't approach first while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available. Right after Skarner uses E, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow him and gain movement speed, then trade with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites.
Skarner.laning: When Skarner steps forward to last-hit, hit him first with Yorick E Mourning Mist; if it misses, don't approach. Watch your positioning so Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can't push you into a wall.
Skarner.phase: In the mid and late game, use side lane pressure, but the longer Skarner has to build items, the greater the risk of being caught and taking damage.
Skarner.teamfight: Raise Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team's backline. Engage after Skarner's crowd control has been used on an ally, then hit an enemy key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Attack the target being hit by the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, so don't stand with your back to a wall. If you get stunned against a wall, the dash's cooldown is greatly reduced, so back off with his next engage in mind. Also watch out for the suppression from Skarner R Impale, and don't try to interrupt a suppression that's already started with Yorick W Dark Procession.

TahmKench.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Tahm Kench's main damage. Include armor penetration to account for his high armor. After completing one core item, fit in Executioner's Calling to counter healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin.
TahmKench.combo: Place Yorick W Dark Procession in Tahm Kench's escape path first, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist and follow with an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites and basic attacks. If there are enough graves nearby, use Yorick Q Last Rites again after spending the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers. Follow and attack the target marked by the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
TahmKench.escape: The opening to engage comes after Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, don't go in; back off until the stacks disappear. When you can approach safely, block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession.
TahmKench.fight: Prepare graves ahead of time, then hit Tahm Kench with Yorick E Mourning Mist when he steps forward to last-hit. Approach only after he's marked and slowed, then land an empowered basic attack from Yorick Q Last Rites. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into a shield or healing, so avoid short trades where you chip away at him and back off.
TahmKench.laning: Clear the wave on your side to stack graves, and keep your distance behind minions when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable. If Tahm Kench pushes the lane and leaves, gain an advantage by pressuring his turret.
TahmKench.phase: In the mid and late game, once you have your items, pressure a side lane. Don't force an engage in a standoff with five players grouped together.
TahmKench.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team's backline. Create space to avoid the area knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, and engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally. Mark a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist, but account for Tahm Kench R Devour being available to protect them by swallowing them.
TahmKench.watch: If you think Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to disappear. Taking more hits from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can lead to a stun and an opening for Tahm Kench R Devour. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, avoid its landing spot and create space from your allies.

Teemo.build: Teemo Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap deal his main magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. Prepare Oracle Lens to clear mushrooms from key routes.
Teemo.combo: Place Yorick W Dark Procession in the direction Teemo is likely to retreat first, then slow and mark him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Approach after the blind from Teemo Q Blinding Dart ends, then land Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks and follow-up basic attacks. If there are enough graves nearby, use Q again after spending the empowered attack to raise Mist Walkers.
Teemo.escape: The moment after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is a chance to trade with Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks. Teemo has no way to escape besides Teemo W Move Quick, so hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to close the distance, then block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession. If E misses, stop the engage.
Teemo.fight: When Teemo steps forward to last-hit while Yorick E Mourning Mist is available, hit him with E to slow and mark him, then approach. If E misses or Teemo Q Blinding Dart is still available, don't force an approach just to land Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks. If you've prepared graves, Mist Walkers can also follow E's mark.
Teemo.laning: Avoid short trades where you get hit by Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off, and use a Control Ward to check around bushes without vision or go around them. If Teemo pushes the lane and leaves, gain an advantage by pressuring his turret.
Teemo.phase: In the mid and late game, pressure a side lane, but Yorick has less impact in a standoff with five players grouped together.
Teemo.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team's backline. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send Mist Walkers after them. Expect Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages, and use Oracle Lens to check key routes.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks, so don't try to use Q attacks until the blind wears off. Even one basic attack from Teemo E Toxic Shot applies ongoing poison damage, so stay out of range if you aren't ready to close in. Also watch out for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in bushes without vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives.

Trundle.build: Prioritize armor against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage based on your maximum health and reduces your resistances, so prioritize creating distance over trying to withstand it by stacking health or resistances. Fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item to counter Trundle's healing.
Trundle.combo: Prepare graves and place Yorick W Dark Procession in the direction of Trundle's escape path first. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and land Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks and basic attacks. After spending Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks, use it again to raise Mist Walkers if there are enough graves nearby.
Trundle.escape: The opening to engage comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, delay the engage and create distance.
Trundle.fight: Back away from Trundle W Frozen Domain, and only close in when you've hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Once he's marked and slowed, trade with Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks and follow-up basic attacks. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, don't fight him; create distance.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King's Tribute heals him whenever an enemy unit dies, so don't prolong a fight where you only chip away at his health in front of a large wave. Look for Yorick E Mourning Mist when Trundle steps forward to last-hit, and don't approach if it misses.
Trundle.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path to stop Trundle from approaching, or protect your team's backline. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then hit an enemy key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send Mist Walkers after them. Attack the target being hit by the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles.
Trundle.watch: Inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed and healing are stronger, so retreat outside it and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape, so fight in open terrain and immediately move to the side when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tankier, so create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Fit Executioner's Calling in after completing one core item to counter his healing. Since he relies on basic attacks, also consider Thornmail.
Tryndamere.combo: Right after Tryndamere uses E Spinning Slash, block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession. Then apply the mark and slow with Yorick E Mourning Mist, and land Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks and follow-up basic attacks. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, create distance and wait it out rather than pouring in more attacks.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is Yorick's opening to engage. If you've just been hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, avoid a basic attack trade.
Tryndamere.fight: When Tryndamere steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use the slow and movement speed to land Yorick Q Last Rites empowered attacks. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don't approach. Avoid a basic attack trade right after being hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.laning: Manage the wave on your side to stack graves, and create distance when Tryndamere starts building Fury. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.phase: In the mid and late game, once you have your items, focus on side lane pressure, but don't try to take Tryndamere alone while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team's backline. Engage after the enemy uses crowd control on an ally, then hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send Mist Walkers after them. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage activates, create distance and wait out its duration.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury stacks up, his critical strikes are threatening, and he heals with Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. Create distance when he starts hitting minions to build Fury. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can't die, so don't pour in damage; wait out its duration.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. However, Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all his damage. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, slot in Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist before landing Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack. If you have enough graves, cast Yorick Q Last Rites again to raise the Mist Walkers and continue with basic attacks.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to engage. You can trade back after taking one stun, since the same target can’t be stunned again for a while. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, so wait until the awakening ends, then block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession.
Udyr.fight: Prepare graves in advance. Approach only after hitting Udyr with Yorick E Mourning Mist when he steps forward. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, pressure him with Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers so he has no chance to heal.
Udyr.laning: Early on, manage your CS and health with Yorick Q Last Rites, and build graves by clearing the wave on your side. Don’t step forward when Udyr is out of sight; ward key paths and jungle entrances. If Udyr pushes the lane and leaves, take the advantage by pressuring the turret.
Udyr.phase: Once you have your items in the mid and late game, pressure the side lane, but you are less effective in standoffs with five players grouped together.
Udyr.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team’s backline. If Udyr can withstand damage with defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, don’t try to take him down first; target a weaker enemy behind him. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your team, and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede dashes in quickly and stuns, so don’t step forward right after Udyr changes stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm also slows, so don’t stay close to him for an extended fight.

Urgot.build: Build armor first against Urgot’s main damage. Since Urgot tends to have high armor, add penetration to boost Yorick’s physical damage.
Urgot.combo: After Urgot E Disdain is down, place Yorick W Dark Procession in his escape path first. Then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, use the movement speed boost to close in, and land Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack followed by another attack. If there are enough graves nearby and you’ve used the empowered attack, cast Yorick Q Last Rites again to raise the Mist Walkers.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so the moment after you make him use it is your window to engage. Block his escape with Yorick W Dark Procession, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then approach. Don’t engage while Urgot E Disdain is available or if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Urgot.fight: Keep your distance while Urgot E Disdain is available, since he can cross Yorick W Dark Procession with it. Only close in with the slow and movement speed boost when Urgot steps forward to last-hit and you can hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist, then use Yorick Q Last Rites. Staying near Urgot too long lets his leg cannon damage build up, so move just outside its short range after the trade.
Urgot.laning: Prepare graves by clearing the wave on your side, and don’t approach Urgot when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable. If Urgot pushes the lane and leaves, take the advantage by pressuring the turret.
Urgot.phase: Once you have your items in the mid and late game, focus on pressuring side lanes and avoid forcing fights in standoffs with five players grouped together.
Urgot.teamfight: Prepare Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team’s backline. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so you can stand in front to protect the damage dealers behind you. Engage after the enemy’s crowd control has been used on your team, and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send the Mist Walkers after them.
Urgot.watch: If Urgot E Disdain catches you, you can easily take follow-up hits while stunned, so don’t give him an angle to engage and keep your distance. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you and marks you for Urgot W Purge, so dodge the charge. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of range before your health reaches the execution threshold.

Volibear.build: After completing one core item, slot in Executioner's Calling to counter the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. Volibear P The Relentless Storm and E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all his damage.
Volibear.combo: Prepare graves in advance, then place Yorick W Dark Procession toward Volibear’s escape path and mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. Follow with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack and another attack; if you have enough graves, cast Yorick Q Last Rites again to raise the Mist Walkers. If Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer is available, he can cross Yorick W Dark Procession, so don’t rely on it to trap him.
Volibear.escape: Wait out the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash outside attack range, then look for an opportunity to engage. If Volibear R Stormbringer is unavailable, Yorick W Dark Procession can be useful for blocking his escape. If only one of Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer is down, account for the remaining mobility and don’t chase too far.
Volibear.fight: When Volibear steps forward to last-hit, hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to get the slow and movement speed boost, then trade with Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack. If Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, don’t force an approach. If Volibear has built stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions, avoid fighting and look for an opportunity after the stacks expire.
Volibear.laning: Start a trade with Yorick E Mourning Mist only when Volibear steps forward, and keep your distance when Yorick E Mourning Mist is unavailable. Manage your health with Yorick Q Last Rites, and take the advantage by pressuring the turret if Volibear pushes the lane and leaves.
Volibear.phase: Once you have your items in the mid and late game, pressure the side lane, but don’t rely on your turret for safety at low health while Volibear R Stormbringer is available.
Volibear.teamfight: Prepare graves and Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team’s backline. Attack the target marked by the Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles alongside her to deal extra damage.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear turns on Volibear Q Thundering Smash and runs at you, wait it out from outside his range so you don’t get hit by the empowered attack’s stun. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. After Volibear W Frenzied Maul hits you, be careful not to give him a chance to hit you again and heal. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret at low health.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first because most of the damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath is physical. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: When you trade, break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then mark and slow him with Yorick E Mourning Mist. When you have a kill opportunity, place Yorick W Dark Procession in Yasuo’s escape path in advance, then chain Yorick E Mourning Mist into Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack. Account for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or Yasuo R Last Breath being able to carry him over the wall if either is available.
Yasuo.escape: Look to engage just after Yasuo throws his tornado, when his airborne stacks reset. Don’t engage just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down; use crowd control and Yorick W Dark Procession together to catch him before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: Start a fight when Yasuo steps forward to last-hit or immediately after he throws his tornado. Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first, then hit him with Yorick E Mourning Mist to slow Yasuo and gain a movement speed boost before landing Yorick Q Last Rites’ empowered attack. Don’t approach if Yorick E Mourning Mist misses.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can use to dash in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Manage your health and farm with Yorick Q Last Rites, and pressure the turret if Yasuo pushes the wave and roams.
Yasuo.phase: Once you have your items in the mid and late game, pressure the side lane and avoid standoffs with five players grouped together.
Yasuo.teamfight: Raise Mist Walkers before a fight, and use Yorick W Dark Procession to block a narrow path or protect your team’s backline. Engage after Yasuo’s crowd control has been used on your team, and hit a key damage dealer with Yorick E Mourning Mist to send the Mist Walkers after them. Attack the target struck by the Maiden from Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles alongside her.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, the next tornado knocks you airborne, so watch for the stacks and dodge to the side. If Yasuo E Sweeping Blade catches you as he dashes through minions, it’s difficult for Yorick to get away, so keep your distance. While Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, remember that it blocks projectiles and save your key abilities.
